mechanism.claim: At a fixed eight-hour boundary in an unusually volatile completed BTC block, a final two-hour move that opposes and is no larger than half of the preceding six-hour move while carrying at least 30% of block quote volume marks participation-backed absorption rather than a shallow low-volume pullback. Follow the absorbing final-two-hour direction for six elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict nonzero sign of completed final-two-hour return, opposite the first-six-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSAR uses fixed 8h blocks, a 6h shock plus 2h opposing path, and quote-volume concentration to distinguish absorption. HVTPR followed the original trend after a 3h/1h shallow pullback with implied-volatility levels; DLVCR used daily same-direction late continuation. Neither event set nor diagnostic control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three sparse UTC absorption clocks with within-block volume migration are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 480 exact distinct minute rows in [decision-8h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume, positive block quote volume; no imputation
features.late_quote_volume_share: final-two-hour quote volume divided by full-block quote volume
features.realized_variation: sum squared 1m close-to-close log returns within the completed block
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 270 valid fixed eight-hour blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.absorption: early and late returns have opposite strict signs, abs(late)<=0.50*abs(early), late quote-volume share>=0.30

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, volume, or subset repair.
